payout_quote: Seeking Healthy Male & Female Volunteers (ATHENA): Pharmaron, located in downtown Baltimore, is currently seeking healthy male & female volunteers to participate in a clinical research study to evaluate GS-3242 that is being developed for the potential treatment of HIV-1. To qualify you must be: Ages: 18-45 at screening; BMI: 19 - 30 at screening; Non-smokers; Must be available for an inpatient period of 29 days/28 nights with approximately 18 follow-up visits and 6 follow-up phone calls. Qualified participants will be compensated up to $26,300 for their study-related time and travel.
steps: Open Pharmaron's official US recruitment page (pharmaron.com > Clinical Trial Recruitment - US) and pick a currently recruiting study you fit (e.g. ATHENA healthy-volunteer study, Crypto, AMETHYST 0/1, QUARTZ).
Contact the Baltimore recruitment department at 240.673.0900 or email baltimore.recruiter@pharmaron-us.com to register.
Pass the medical screening and meet the study qualifications (e.g. ATHENA: healthy male/female, 18-45, BMI 19-30, non-smoker).
Complete the full schedule: for ATHENA, a 29-day/28-night inpatient period plus ~18 follow-up visits and 6 follow-up phone calls.
Receive the study compensation (up to $26,300 for ATHENA) for your study-related time and travel.
catches: You must pass medical screening and meet strict qualifications (e.g. ATHENA: healthy 18-45, BMI 19-30, non-smoker); not everyone qualifies.
The $26,300 is an 'up to' ceiling for qualified participants who complete the full schedule; other listed studies pay $4,450-$12,050.
Enormous time commitment: ATHENA demands a 29-day/28-night inpatient stay plus ~18 follow-up visits and 6 phone calls - this is over a month of your life.
You receive an investigational study drug (e.g. GS-3242, developed for potential HIV-1 treatment) with real medical risks and side effects.
Studies are at Pharmaron's downtown Baltimore facility - travel/lodging is your own arrangement; compensation is tied to study-related time and travel.
biggest_catch: The headline $26,300 (ATHENA study) requires 28 nights locked in Pharmaron's Baltimore clinic plus ~18 follow-up visits and 6 phone calls - over a month of your life - and you must pass strict health screening (not everyone qualifies) while taking an investigational drug with real side-effect risks.
eligibility: Study-specific healthy-volunteer criteria (ATHENA: healthy males/females 18-45, BMI 19-30, non-smokers; other studies recruit overweight/obese adults 18-65 with BMI>=27, or healthy males 18-55); must pass medical screening.
timing: Compensation for study-related time and travel is paid for participating in the study; amounts depend on completing the scheduled inpatient stay and follow-up visits.
